name: Anarch Thaumaturgical Rituals — 1 Basic — Iron Body

system.description: Similar to the Fortitude Discipline, this ritual toughens the caster against injury. For every 10 minutes spent performing it (to a maximum of 40 minutes), the effect lasts one hour and converts one level of aggravated damage sustained during that time to lethal damage instead; a full 40-minute casting grants four hours of protection converting up to four levels of aggravated damage. Additional aggravated damage beyond that amount, or inflicted after the ritual ends, is unaffected, and the ritual cannot be recast until the current casting expires. It must be performed during actual game time, and the subject must carry a spent shell casing for the duration.
system.duration: One hour per 10 minutes cast (max 4 hours)
